crossRefs.note: Look! Praise Yahweh, all you servants of Yahweh, who stand by night in Yahweh’s house!
You also, as living stones, are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual…
and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests to his God and Father—to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever.…
The first creature was like a lion, and the second creature like a calf, and the third creature had a face like a man…
Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each…

parallels.note: His servants said to him, “See now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings. Please let…

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
translations.bsb: Let the house of Aaron say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
translations.kjv: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
translations.asv: Let the house of Aaron now say, That his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
